predecessors.name: Great Seljuk Empire
predecessors.text: Hisn Kayfa, 'granted ... as a iqtâ' to the Artuqids in 1101/1102' (Hasankeyf page)

predecessors.name: Marwanids of Diyar Bakr
predecessors.text: Diyar Bakr, the Marwanid land the Artuqids page lists as a predecessor in its infobox

successors.name: Sultanate of Rum
successors.text: Harput (Kharput), the Artuqid branch of Harput

ledger.x: 1102: the Seljuk sultan grants Hisn Kayfa (Hasankeyf) to the Artuqids as an iqta'; the Hasankeyf page: the sultan 'granted Hisn Kayfa as a iqtâ' to the Artuqids in 1101/1102'; the Artuqids infobox gives 1102 as the foundation.
1117: Ilghazi gains control of Aleppo after Lu'lu's assassination (Ilghazi page; the Artuqids narrative says 1118, its Aleppo section 1117-1128).
1118: Ilghazi takes Mayyafariqin and pacifies the surrounding countryside (Ilghazi page); the page does not name the previous holder.
ledger.cp: holder not named by the page

ledger.x: 1119: Ager Sanguinis (28 June) hands the Antiochene frontier towns to Ilghazi.
1119: Baldwin II recovers the lost towns after winning at Hab on 14 August.
1120: Ilghazi takes Nisibin (Nusaybin) (Ilghazi page); the page does not name the previous holder.
ledger.cp: holder not named by the page

ledger.x: 1185: Harput becomes an independent Artuqid principality under Imad ud-din Abu Bakr (1185-1204).
1198: the Hasankeyf branch conquers Amid (Diyarbakir) (Artuqids page); the page does not name the previous holder, and also dates the move of the Hasankeyf capital to Diyarbakir to 1183.
ledger.cp: holder not named by the page

ledger.x: 1231: the Ayyubids demolish the Hasankeyf centre after its ruler tried to ally with the Seljuks.
1232: the Ayyubid campaign ends with the capture of Hasankeyf in November.
1234: Kayqubad I, Seljuk sultan of Rum, conquers Harput and ends the Harput branch (Artuqids page; its lead gives 1233 as the end of independence).
1409: the Qara Qoyunlu conquer Mardin, ending Artuqid rule; Qara Muhammad had received the submission of Majd al-Din Isa in 1384.
1409: the Qara Qoyunlu conquer Mardin and the Artuqid dynasty ends.

wars.name: Battle of Harran
wars.outcome: Sökmen defeated the Crusaders at the Battle of Harran in 1104; no border change recorded on the page.

wars.name: Battle of Ager Sanguinis
wars.outcome: Artuqid victory on 28 June 1119 under Ilghazi; the Antiochene frontier towns fell, and Baldwin II recovered 'some of the lost towns' after the Battle of Hab on 14 August.

wars.name: Battle of Didgori
wars.outcome: Ilghazi invaded Georgia and was defeated by David IV at Didgori in 1121 (Ilghazi page); no border change.

wars.name: Zengid conquest of Aleppo
wars.outcome: Zengi took Aleppo from the Artuqids in 1128.

wars.name: Ayyubid conquest of Hasankeyf and Amid
wars.outcome: Amid surrendered to al-Kamil by 18 October 1232 and Hasankeyf was captured in November 1232; the Hasankeyf branch ended.

wars.name: Rum conquest of Harput
wars.outcome: Kayqubad I conquered Harput in 1234, ending the Harput branch.

wars.name: Qara Qoyunlu conquest of Mardin
wars.outcome: Qara Muhammad received the submission of Majd al-Din Isa in 1384; the Qara Qoyunlu conquered Mardin in 1409.

certainty.note: Iqta' holdings round fortress towns (Hasankeyf, Mardin, Amid, Harput) with no surveyed frontier on the pages opened; discs are drawn round the named towns and are approximate.
